duration: As stated in the agreement or to be refined in review.
effective_date: Upon full execution by the parties unless otherwise specified.
payment_terms: Administrator may pay funeral bills and urgent property expenses first; administrator will keep receipts; administrator will provide monthly accounting updates; administrator will be reimbursed for reasonable costs; distributions occur only after all debts and taxes are handled; major assets cannot be sold without majority written approval.
purpose: Set clear rules for administering a late father’s estate, including payment priority, reimbursement of reasonable costs, reporting, asset sale restrictions, distribution timing, replacement upon resignation, and confidentiality regarding family finances.
title: Agreement
